answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The harbor is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the timber. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, reduced by each unverified claim, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ridge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
